module.purpose: This file verifies seated round-robin booking behavior when a second attendee claims a seat, ensuring the existing assigned host remains the organizer and unrelated team members are excluded from calendar attendees.
module.summary: An integration-style Vitest scenario constructs a seated round-robin event with an already accepted booking, mocks video meeting creation, invokes the new-booking workflow, and inspects the calendar attendee update. The assertions protect host assignment and verify that the calendar event contains an explicitly empty team-member list rather than the other eligible hosts.
module.businessContext: Supports team scheduling for multi-seat round-robin events. A failure could assign the wrong organizer or expose unrelated team members in calendar invitations.
functions: test (~L25-170): Verifies organizer preservation and team-member exclusion for second-seat bookings

edgeCases.inputShape: Second attendee occupies another seat in an already accepted three-seat booking.
edgeCases.behavior: Preserves the original assigned host and excludes the two other team members from calendar attendees.

edgeCases.inputShape: Existing booking already contains video meeting metadata and a reference.
edgeCases.behavior: Uses the existing meeting context while supplying deterministic successful meeting-creation data.

edgeCases.inputShape: Calendar event team member collection is absent.
edgeCases.behavior: The test requires the collection to be defined and fails when it is missing.

invariants.description: The existing booking is accepted and assigned to the designated host before the second seat is processed.
Calendar attendee synchronization is invoked during second-seat booking processing.
The calendar event organizer remains the originally assigned host.
The calendar event exposes a defined team list containing zero members.

assumptions.description: The booking workflow accepts the generated mock booking request and performs calendar synchronization.
Calendar event objects expose organizer and optional team members with email fields.
Shared scenario setup runs before the test creates booking fixtures.

ambiguities.question: Does the scenario helper persist fixtures in a database or another external test store?
Is the empty team-member list guaranteed by production behavior or only by this specific event configuration?

concurrencyModel.notes: The test awaits fixture creation and booking processing sequentially, with deterministic mocks and assertions.

detail.signature: test("For second seat booking, organizer remains the same with no team members included", async () => {
preconditions: An existing accepted seated round-robin booking has the assigned host as its organizer and one existing attendee.
The event type has three configured hosts and three seats per time slot.
The booking request represents a second seated attendee.
postconditions: The calendar attendee update operation is called.
The calendar event organizer is the assigned host.
The calendar event team is defined with zero members.
Neither configured non-organizer team member is included in the calendar event team.
invariants: The assigned host remains the organizer when the second seat is booked.
Configured team members other than the assigned host are not added to the calendar event team for this booking.
edgeCases: A second seat booking in a seated round-robin event with multiple configured hosts produces an empty team member list rather than including the other configured hosts.
detail.summary: Verifies that creating a second seat booking preserves the assigned host as the calendar event organizer and excludes other team members from the calendar event team.
